subject: [RFC PATCH 3/7] mm, fs: handle memory.high overage in buffered reads and writes

2026-11-22.patch_summary: This patch addresses the issue of memory.high overage in buffered reads and writes by moving the throttling logic from the charge path to the copy loops in various file systems, including ext4, XFS, btrfs, and tmpfs. This change ensures that memory usage is properly accounted for during large I/O operations, preventing excessive memory allocation under memory.high constraints. The patch also takes into account specific lock-holding scenarios in certain file systems, such as gfs2 and ocfs2, to prevent deadlocks. By handling the overage in the copy loops, this patch aims to improve system stability and prevent memory-related issues during large I/O operations.
